Benchmark.title: OCM container image checks supplementing the GPOS SRG profile
Benchmark.description: Checks GPOS SRG requirements against OCM's scratch images, which contain a static Go binary built against the Go Cryptographic Module and a CA bundle.

Value.title: Root filesystem of the image under test
Value.description: Directory holding the exported root filesystem of the scanned image.

Value.title: File with the expected CA bundle digest
Value.description: File holding the sha256 of the CA bundle in the digest-pinned base image.

Rule.title: Cryptography runs in a FIPS-validated module
Rule.description: Every Go executable is built with GOFIPS140=v<version> and defaults to fips140=on, so all of OCM's cryptography runs in the Go Cryptographic Module (CMVP certificate #5247 for v1.0.0). The images contain no other cryptographic library.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203649, SV-203739, SV-203750, SV-203751 and SV-203776, which the Chainguard profile checks for an OpenSSL FIPS provider.

Rule.title: Only approved trust anchors are installed
Rule.description: The only certificate file is /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, and it is byte-identical to the CA bundle of the digest-pinned Garden Linux FIPS base image.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-263659, which the Chainguard profile checks against Wolfi's build-time CA bundle digests.

Rule.title: No shared libraries, package manager, or setuid/setgid files
Rule.description: The image contains no shared libraries or dynamic loader, no package manager or package database, no setuid/setgid files, and no world-writable location without the sticky bit.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203675 (library permissions) and SV-203716 (user installation of software): with a static binary and no package manager there are no library permissions to change and no way to install software.

Rule.title: No audit or log data is stored in the image
Rule.description: The image has no /var/log and no log files. OCM writes logs and error messages to stdout/stderr, which the container runtime collects and protects.
Rule.rationale: Covers SV-203616, SV-203617 (protect audit information) and SV-203664 (error messages only to authorized users), which the Chainguard profile checks through /var/log permissions.
